recent.text: On this day, the New Orleans Pelicans have the dubious distinction of suffering their worst regular season loss in franchise history, a 138-87 loss to the Golden State Warriors. It eclipses a 49-point (153-104) defeat the Heat several seasons ago (4/11/2025).
